info.description:
Read-only publication of the SIS data in Open Education API v6.0 shapes (/oeapi).

Every endpoint needs a Bearer access token with scope sis.read from one of
the token issuers SIS trusts (sis.auth.issuers).

Lists use the OEAPI page envelope and pageNumber/pageSize. A record
is addressed by its sourcedId, and references between records are
sourcedIds, so every relationship can be followed through this API.
sort and filter are not supported and answer 400.
info.title: SIS Open Education API (OEAPI) v6.0

error.description:
Error is "unauthorized" (401: missing, invalid or expired token, or
one from an untrusted issuer), "forbidden" (403: the token lacks the
required scope) or "unavailable" (503: the token's issuer could not be
reached to check it; retry later).

result.description: Result is the person's result in the offering, when there is one.

BearerAuth.description: Access token prefixed with "Bearer ", e.g. "Bearer eyJhbGciOi...".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
